window_configuration.session_date_ownership: CME trading date; bars from the prior-calendar-day 18:01 reopen belong to the following trading session_date
window_configuration.bar_membership_rule: A conceptual [start, end) market-time window uses one-minute bar-end labels start+1 minute through end, inclusive.

gap_definition.prior_close: close of prior trading session bar stamped 17:00 ET
gap_definition.reopen: open of current session first bar stamped 18:01 ET on prior calendar day
gap_definition.filled: price touched/crossed the prior close at or before the 09:30 bar-end
gap_definition.partial: price moved from reopen toward prior close without touching it
gap_definition.open: no fill; includes partial and untouched through 09:30

key_level_definitions.trade_through: strict move beyond the level from the OR-open side
key_level_definitions.sweep: strict trade-through followed by OR close on the original side
key_level_definitions.close_through: OR close on the opposite side from OR open
key_level_definitions.reject: touch or beyond followed by OR close on the original side; sweep is a strict subset
